rereport.closure_text: Completed by Task - Thank you for reaching out regarding this intersection. We had a crew inspect all pedestrian (PED) push buttons at the intersection and confirmed that all buttons and indicator lights are functioning properly. The pedestrian crossing phase, during which all vehicular traffic is stopped, occurs after the main street traffic phase. If the pedestrian push button is activated after the main street phase has already been completed, pedestrians will need to wait until the next signal cycle for the WALK indication.
